Schedule of Variations and S1 DD-120 398.50 from 2025-07-01 (p37-38)
note: Two open points, both given as alternatives. (1) Class: DD-120 is class-rated and the well class is fixed by the call-off (Cl.4, App A, P2/P3), which is not supplied; the invoice header states Standard and the billed rate 384.15 is the Standard rate, so rate_differs holds only under Extended Reach/HPHT. (2) Hours: Cl.21 charges DD-120 per circulating hour recorded (8 -> 7 after Cl.21A), but Sch 8 says DD-120 is charged for each circulating OR back-reaming hour recorded (8 + 3 = 11 -> 10 after Cl.21A), and Cl.2 says a Schedule prevails over a Part. Sch 8 gives the identical wording to RM-530, which suggests a distributive description (circulating hours for DD-120, back-reaming hours for RM-530, which Cl.30 counts), and I think that reading (7 h) is the stronger one; but the literal Sch 8 text with Cl.2 precedence gives 10 h, which is exactly what was billed. Under the Cl.21 reading the 10 billed hours exceed the 7 supported (quantity_above_report); under the Sch 8 reading they do not. The Sch 8 reading assumes the back-reaming hours are not already inside the 8 circulating hours; the report lists them separately. The 24-hour daily limit (Sch 3 Pt 5) needs other lines and is not applied.
